report.summary: Chunk 1 of daedalus/council/vendors.py: module docstring, imports, constants, identity functions, VendorReply/FloorRefusal/RunResult dataclasses. Claims about transport-only status, no write path, no verdict fields, egress controls, and independence verification protocol are checkable and kept; some claims (e.g., about other files) are uncheckable.
risks: line 1 | medium | Module docstring claims 'Nothing here writes, edits, applies or promotes anything.' This chunk defines RunResult with fields 'patches_applied', 'patches_rejected', 'patches_pending' that suggest write-related outcomes. | Check if RunResult is used only for reading/reporting or actually triggers writes elsewhere.

line 1 | low | Module docstring states 'Council records are NEVER an input to memory recall, and nothing in this module touches memstore.' No memstore import or reference in this chunk. | Verify no memstore usage in later chunks or other modules.

line 1 | low | Module docstring claims 'the secret floor runs PER FILE before any bytes leave the process' with path and content channels. This chunk defines FloorRefusal with channel field but no implementation of secret floor logic. | Confirm secret floor implementation exists in later chunks or other modules.

line 1 | low | Module docstring references 'docs/bypasses.md §2' and 'docs/adrs/010-naming-namespaces.md' – these files are not in this chunk. | Ensure referenced documentation exists and is consistent.

handoff.purpose: Declare module-level docstring, imports, constants, identity functions, and value types for vendor replies and run results.

symbols.name: STATUSES
symbols.note: Tuple of five transport-status strings: ok, unavailable, timeout, refused_by_floor, error.

symbols.name: LANES
symbols.note: Tuple of two egress-lane strings: trusted, untrusted.

symbols.name: UNAVAILABLE_REASONS
symbols.note: Tuple of ten machine-readable reason strings for unavailability.

symbols.name: DEFAULT_BENCH_OLLAMA_HOST
symbols.note: Default Ollama host for bench: http://100.119.126.9:11434

symbols.name: DEFAULT_LOCAL_OLLAMA_HOST
symbols.note: Default local Ollama host: http://127.0.0.1:11434 (explicit IPv4 to avoid IPv6 miss).

symbols.name: PROMPT_DATA_NOTICE
symbols.note: String prepended to every outbound prompt warning that evidence is data, not instructions.

symbols.name: _slug
symbols.note: Sanitizes a string for use in an actor segment by replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens.

symbols.name: actor_id
symbols.note: Returns council.<vendor>.<model> actor ID, delegating to bus.actor_id after slugifying vendor and model.

symbols.name: model_family
symbols.note: Returns coarse weight family string for independence grouping; over-merges by stripping tags and trailing size/version tokens.

symbols.name: VendorReply
symbols.note: Dataclass for one vendor's answer; carries transport status, content, provenance; no verdict fields.

symbols.name: FloorRefusal
symbols.note: Dataclass for a secret-floor hit; names rule and channel, never matched bytes.

symbols.name: RunResult
symbols.note: Dataclass (partially shown) for run results; fields include patches_applied, patches_rejected, patches_pending.

claims.text: This module produces EVIDENCE, never a decision.
claims.why: VendorReply has no approve/reject/verdict/score field; status is transport only.

claims.text: status here is a TRANSPORT status (did the bytes make the round trip), not a judgement about the work under review.
claims.why: STATUSES tuple defined as transport outcomes; 'ok' means bytes came back, nothing more.

claims.text: Nothing here writes, edits, applies or promotes anything.
claims.why: This chunk defines only constants, identity functions, and dataclasses; no write operations present.

claims.text: Council profiles are deliberately NOT adapters.subprocess_adapter.RUNTIME_PROFILES: those carry --sandbox workspace-write and --permission-mode dontAsk and spawn in the primary checkout
claims.why: No definition of CouncilProfile or comparison with RUNTIME_PROFILES in this chunk.

claims.text: A reviewer must be a COMPLETION, NOT AN AGENT
claims.why: Claims about codex/claude subprocess flags and temp directory are not verifiable in this chunk.

claims.text: The secret floor runs PER FILE before any bytes leave the process
claims.why: No implementation of secret floor logic in this chunk; only FloorRefusal dataclass defined.

claims.text: A hit REFUSES the call (status='refused_by_floor'); there is no redact-and-send, and the runner is never invoked.
claims.why: No secret floor call or runner invocation logic in this chunk.

claims.text: OLLAMA_HOST is NEVER set, mutated or inherited by anything in this module.
claims.why: No reference to OLLAMA_HOST in this chunk; host is passed explicitly via constants.

claims.text: the host is passed explicitly per call, and whether it counts as local is decided by sensitivity.lane_for_host
claims.why: lane_for_host imported from sensitivity; no local-host table in this module.

claims.text: NUMERIC LOOPBACK ONLY: localhost does NOT count, because a name is a DNS indirection the predicate cannot see through.
claims.why: Claim about lane_for_host behavior is not verifiable in this chunk; implementation is in sensitivity module.

claims.text: Council records are NEVER an input to memory recall, and nothing in this module touches memstore.
claims.why: No import or reference to memstore in this chunk.

claims.text: A bare actor: 'claude' in a durable record is a defect
claims.why: actor_id returns council.<vendor>.<model> format, not bare vendor name.

claims.text: The FORMAT is delegated to bus.actor_id so the id on a transcript turn and the id on the reply that produced it cannot drift apart
claims.why: actor_id calls _bus_actor_id after slugifying; delegation is explicit.

claims.text: this function only normalises the raw model id first (a raw qwen2.5-coder:7b would otherwise put a colon in a durable identifier)
claims.why: _slug replaces colons with hyphens; actor_id calls _slug on model before passing to _bus_actor_id.

claims.text: The unit of independence is WEIGHTS, not endpoints.
claims.why: model_family strips endpoint-specific parts (tags, version numbers) to group by weight family.

claims.text: Over-merging costs a seat; under-merging silently fakes independence.
claims.why: model_family uses aggressive stripping (rsplit, re.split, pop trailing tokens) to over-merge.

claims.text: Deliberately carries NO approve/reject/pass/verdict/ok/score/confidence field, and must never grow one
claims.why: VendorReply fields are vendor, actor, model, status, content, latency_s, reason, stderr, usage, independence_class, endpoint, cli_version, lane, local, withheld; none are approve/reject/verdict/score/confidence.

claims.text: status is transport, content is prose for a human and for a claim extractor
claims.why: status is from STATUSES; content is string field.

observations.what: RunResult dataclass is partially shown; its fields include 'patches_applied', 'patches_rejected', 'patches_pending' which may imply write-related outcomes, potentially conflicting with the module docstring's claim that nothing writes.
Module docstring references 'docs/bypasses.md §2' and 'docs/adrs/010-naming-namespaces.md' but these files are not present in this chunk.
Secret floor logic is referenced in docstring but not implemented in this chunk; only FloorRefusal dataclass is defined.
The claim about lane_for_host behavior (numeric loopback only) cannot be verified from this chunk alone.
